# Attack marker: four pale corner brackets round a tile (0.9 m) and a small X in the middle, 0.08 m
# over the floor. Origin: on the floor at the tile's centre. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Glow --base-color 0.7020 0.7647 0.5725 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name H0 --size 1 --location -0.330 -0.405 0.080
scale 0.240 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name V0 --size 1 --location -0.405 -0.330 0.080
scale 0.090 0.240 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name H1 --size 1 --location 0.330 -0.405 0.080
scale 0.240 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name V1 --size 1 --location 0.405 -0.330 0.080
scale 0.090 0.240 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name H2 --size 1 --location -0.330 0.405 0.080
scale 0.240 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name V2 --size 1 --location -0.405 0.330 0.080
scale 0.090 0.240 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name H3 --size 1 --location 0.330 0.405 0.080
scale 0.240 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name V3 --size 1 --location 0.405 0.330 0.080
scale 0.090 0.240 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
add mesh cube --name X0 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.080
scale 0.360 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
set rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
add mesh cube --name X1 --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.080
scale 0.360 0.090 0.030
apply --scale
material assign Glow
set rotation 0 0 -45
apply --rotation
select all
